name: constants
independent_expectation: Closed result 0,1; exact Unit/product tree retained, no quantum creation.

name: truth-operations
independent_expectation: Open truth table by (a,b): 00->100,01->110,10->010,11->001. The closed wrapper probes only10.

name: copy-drop
independent_expectation: Ordinary copy/drop, one exact product argument; closed wrapper returns00.

name: mixed-passthrough
independent_expectation: Open quantum state/reference is unchanged while b flips; closed wrapper returns10/11 with probability1/2 each.

name: classical-control
independent_expectation: For explicit ordinary b, action is I orX and b is retained. Closed probe returns11; open reference behavior needs a later API oracle.

name: measured-feedback
independent_expectation: Independent per-outcome map K_c=<c| tensor X^c. Closed probe returns00/11 with probability1/2 each; at most two qubits.

name: measured-logic
independent_expectation: Outcomes follow the independent truth table; closed probe returns110/001 with probability1/2 each. Output classical computation is not an invertible quantum operator.

name: unit-observation-retention
independent_expectation: Closed wrapper returns1; both measurements/owner consumptions must remain. Reference oracle later sums density matrices over the ignored measurement label.

name: eager-and-observation
independent_expectation: Result0 does not permit removing the RHS measurement. This is eager Boolean evaluation with Observe effect, not short-circuiting.

name: static-selection
independent_expectation: Explicit static branch chooses an ordinary Bit expression; n=1 probes the1 branch, no implicit Nat-to-Bit conversion.

name: static-as-runtime
independent_expectation: Static Nat is not an ordinary runtime Bit, even when the supplied n is1.

name: runtime-as-static
independent_expectation: Runtime Bit cannot supply a static Nat. Finite Bits/Nat rejection may precede this judgment; do not conflate that with sized staging evidence.
